name: deskpet
description: A transparent desktop puppy companion with optional editor project awareness.

deskpet.launchOnStartup.description: Start Deskpet automatically when the editor starts.

deskpet.scale.description: Scale applied to the source pet artwork.

deskpet.speed.description: Horizontal wandering speed in pixels per second.

deskpet.bottomMargin.description: Distance in pixels between Deskpet and the bottom of the current display.

deskpet.statusBubblePinned.description: Keep the status bubble visible until the user toggles it.

deskpet.bridgeMode.description: Choose where project state comes from: VS Code APIs, an external state-file adapter, or no project bridge.

deskpet.externalStateFile.description: Optional state file path for external Codex or Claude Code adapters when bridgeMode is external. Relative paths resolve from the workspace root.

scripts.check: npm run validate && node --check extension.js && node --check pet-app/main.js && node --check pet-app/preload.js && node --check pet-app/renderer.js && node --check scripts/start.js && node --check scripts/status.js && node --check scripts/stop.js && node --check scripts/event.js && node --check scripts/validate-assets.js
